brief: Create an array of a given length filled with undefined
description: Create a new mutable array of the given length where every entry is undefined. Useful when you want a known length up front before assigning or filling entries. Length must be a non-negative integer and must not exceed 1,000,000. This is a length-based constructor, not a conversion function (see also array(...), which builds from elements).

errorsThrown.reason: length is negative or exceeds the maximum allowed

parameters.description: Number of undefined elements (0 or more, up to the maximum).
parameters.name: length

returns.description: A new array of the requested length; each entry is undefined.
